name: Daily Payment Summary column drawer applies and restores a column change
description:
1. Sign in and open Daily Payment Summary.
2. Open Customize Columns.
3. Turn off the Broker column and apply the change.
4. Confirm the Broker header is hidden.
5. Reopen the drawer, turn Broker back on, and apply.
6. Confirm the Broker header is visible again.
